activity.notes: Francisco Ignacio Madero González (1873-10-30 to 1913-02-22) was the elected constitutional president of Mexico from 6 November 1911 until his forced resignation on 19 February 1913. Link to the existing Mexico polity, not a separate 'Mexico under Madero' polity. His later murder on 22 February is not the end date of his presidential term.
